```python
import pandas as pd

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7cc4acfa-63fd-4acc-a1a1-e8e529e0a97f.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)

cols = ['Burgers', 'Hot Dogs', 'Salads', 'Fries', 'Ice Cream', 'Soda']
subset = df[df['Location'].isin(['Wharvton','Algrimand'])].copy()
subset['Total'] = subset[cols].sum(axis=1)

# Extract totals in a dict
totals = dict(zip(subset['Location'], subset['Total']))
# Compute difference and percent difference vs larger
larger_city = max(totals, key=totals.get)
smaller_city = min(totals, key=totals.get)
diff = totals[larger_city] - totals[smaller_city]
percent_diff_vs_larger = (diff / totals[larger_city]) * 100

print('Totals per city:', totals)
print('Larger city:', larger_city)
print('Difference (larger - smaller):', diff)
print('Percent difference vs larger: {:.2f}%'.format(percent_diff_vs_larger))
```
